title: My little AI Creators i need you Support and Feedback! Would you like to test my Demo and give me Feedback?
author: Life-Heron-6533
selftext:
I spend 8 months to create my game "Get Outta My Gut". Its an roguelite tower defense game. You fight against hordes of enemys and draft turret cards to build up your defense. The whole theme is to protect your body against germs like bacteria, viruses and parasites. 

I really would like to get some more Feedback about my game thats why i ask for your support :D! The Demo is right now free to play on steam -> [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5037960/Get\_Outta\_My\_Gut/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5037960/Get_Outta_My_Gut/)

  
What i did i use for my project:

\- Im honest i mainly used CLAUDE code for this project. No other AI was used.

  
Thanks to all of you <3

comments.author: AshlaStudios
comments.body:
Wanna know my honest opinion? Your main benchmark is clearly Sir We Have an Orc Problem which is a good benchmark to have.   
  
You clearly stepped up production quality in some areas. What you are presenting is quite solid and doesn't look AI made which is nice!

You should analyze marketing behind Sir We Have an Orc problem and take some lessons from it, devs went on a couple of podcast. I guess your hook is the whole biology / living organism aesthetic and vibe. Don't think its a good idea. You need more of a mechanical hook that makes you different from Sir We Have an Orc Problem. 

Plus you should do an asset flip IMO and redo the fantasy from scratch. Its just not interesting. Killing orcs with flamethrowers is so much cooler than killing bacteria inside a body. You could literally do stock fantasy setting and you'd be better off. But maybe I am wrong, that is just me.

Just my two cents, good luck.

replies.author: Life-Heron-6533
replies.body:
I think you have here really good points thanks a lot for your opinion.

I think there is some through behind.

replies.author: AshlaStudios
replies.body: Don't be discouraged though, good job on the project so far, keep at it. You have a strong framework of systems to work on, apply more polish, rethink your marketing strategy and try to pinpoint the gameplay hook that you can use for marketing.
